pages.text: The steel mechanism needs an $(item)aluminium ingot$(), and electrolysis comes much later. A $(item)superheated mixer$() bridges the gap:$(br2)$(item)4 bauxite powder + 1 coal coke dust = 1 aluminium ingot$()

$(li)Crush $(item)bauxite$() with crushing wheels or a millstone to get bauxite powder.$(li)Put a $(item)mechanical mixer$() over a $(item)basin$() on a $(item)blaze burner$(), and feed the burner a $(item)blaze cake$() to make it superheated.$(li)Drop the powder and the dust into the basin.

Later, a chemical vat with electrodes gives aluminium from bauxite powder alone, with extra nuggets.$(br2)$(l)The screwdriver$()$(br)Craft it from $(item)rebar over an aluminium ingot$() (a brass ingot works too). It has $(item)256 uses$(): a deployer holding it wears it down instead of using it up.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
